title: Name the world-championship participants after people, not spellings
description: The final sync_prefix operation re-anchors the 'citation' column on the corrected pair, because that column repeats every player name and tools/build_chronicle.py copies it verbatim into the 'source_ref' of every wch-game claim. catalog/ocn-1.wch.tsv holds one row per game and identifies players by a name string, so the same person appears under several spellings and games by unrelated people were filed into title matches on a surname match. Seven rows are games by people who did not play the match they sit under. Thirteen renames collapse the spellings, twelve of them onto a Wikidata identity already resolved in docs/evidence/people/wikidata-resolved.tsv on 2026-07-31; that pass corrected people.tsv and never reached the game records. The 49 rows naming '?' are absences and are left alone. See docs/evidence/provenance/wch-participant-integrity.md.
